definitions.explanation: Introduces a contrasting point while fully acknowledging the preceding statement. Emphasizes that despite what was said, there is still an important counter-point.

examples.japanese: ⟦{約束|やくそく}した→約束する：05643_yakusokusuru⟧とはいうものの、⟦{実行|じっこう}できる→実行する：22146_jikkousuru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Although I promised, I'm worried whether I can actually do it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧とはいうものの、⟦まだまだ→まだまだ：10505_madamada⟧⟦{未熟|みじゅく}→未熟：13015_mijuku⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Although I have experience, I'm still inexperienced.

examples.japanese: ⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧だとはいうものの、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Although it's spring, cold days continue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{賛成|さんせい}→賛成：02829_sansei⟧だとはいうものの、⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Although I agree, there are conditions.

notes:
GRAMMAR: とはいうものの follows nouns, adjectives, or verb plain forms. It acknowledges the preceding statement more emphatically than とはいえ before introducing a contrasting point.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [noun] + だとはいうものの
- [i-adjective] + とはいうものの
- [na-adjective] + だとはいうものの
- [verb plain] + とはいうものの

REGISTER: Formal, common in written language and speeches.

COMPARISON WITH ⟦とはいえ→とはいえ：06282_tohaie⟧:
- ⟦とはいえ→とはいえ：06282_tohaie⟧: More concise, slightly less emphatic
- とはいうものの: More emphatic, acknowledges the first point more fully before contrasting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦とはいえ→とはいえ：06282_tohaie⟧: Although (shorter, slightly less formal)
- ⟦それにしても→それにしても：08512_sorenishitemo⟧: Even so, nevertheless
- ⟦そうはいっても→そうはいっても：noentry⟧: Having said that
